# Gajan.dev

> DevOps engineering portfolio and free browser-based developer tools.

## Site owner

Gajan Rajah is a DevOps and cloud engineer focused on Linux, Kubernetes, infrastructure automation, observability, and reliable delivery.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://gajan.dev/): DevOps portfolio, technical experience, selected projects, skills, and certifications.
- [Projects](https://gajan.dev/#work): OpenShift, cloud delivery, observability, and software projects.
- [Experience](https://gajan.dev/#about): Professional DevOps and systems engineering background.
- [DevOps Services](https://gajan.dev/services): Selected freelance and contract support for cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation, Kubernetes, OpenShift, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.

## Developer tools

- [Free DevOps Tools](https://gajan.dev/tools): Browser-based utilities for infrastructure and automation work.
- [Cron Editor & Crontab Generator](https://gajan.dev/cron): Build and validate five-field Linux cron expressions with human-readable explanations and timezone-aware run previews.
- [YAML Validator and Formatter](https://gajan.dev/yaml): Browser-based YAML validation, formatting, and troubleshooting.
- [One-Time Secret Sharing](https://gajan.dev/secret): Share a password or token as a self-destructing link. The secret is encrypted in the browser with AES-GCM, only ciphertext is stored, the decryption key stays in the URL fragment, and the link can be opened exactly once.

## Machine-readable resources

- [RSS feed](https://gajan.dev/feed.xml): Published article updates.
- [Full site and article content](https://gajan.dev/llms-full.txt): Complete published portfolio and article content for language-model use.

## Articles

- [Route 53 and TLS Certificates](https://gajan.dev/blog/route-53-and-tls-certificates): A practical guide to AWS Route 53 and TLS certificates covering hosted zones, record types, alias records, routing policies, health checks, ACM issuance and validation, certificate chains, SNI, and HTTPS troubleshooting.
- [Building a Three-Node HA K3s Homelab](https://gajan.dev/blog/three-node-ha-k3s-homelab): A practical RHEL 10.2 and VirtualBox homelab build with three K3s server nodes, embedded etcd, Prometheus, Grafana, and secure Cloudflare Tunnel access.
- [Application Load Balancers](https://gajan.dev/blog/application-load-balancers): A practical guide to AWS Application Load Balancers covering architecture, listeners, routing, target groups, health checks, TLS, monitoring, troubleshooting, and hands-on labs.
- [IAM Roles and Least Privilege](https://gajan.dev/blog/iam-roles-and-least-privilege): A practical guide to AWS IAM roles, trust and permissions policies, temporary credentials, least-privilege design, cross-account access, PassRole, and AccessDenied troubleshooting.
- [AWS Networking Fundamentals](https://gajan.dev/blog/aws-networking-fundamentals): A practical guide to AWS VPC design, routing, NAT gateways, security controls, packet flow, troubleshooting, and multi-AZ networking.
